questions.q: Put the wall pass in order, from first to last.
questions.explain: Yes. Pass first, run around, then your teammate passes it back to you.
choiceExplanations: Yes. Pass first, run around, then your teammate passes it back to you.
Start the run after the ball leaves your foot, so pass first.
The return pass comes last, once you are around the defender.

questions.q: You passed to the left. Tap where you run next.
questions.explain: Right. Curving around the defender gives your teammate a clear pass back to you.
choiceExplanations: Running to your teammate crowds them, and the defender still blocks the way forward.
Right. Curving around the defender gives your teammate a clear pass back to you.
Standing still gives your teammate no pass back, so the wall pass never happens.

questions.q: True or false? The pass back to the runner is open now.
questions.explain: Right, it's false. The defender is in the way, so keep the ball.
choiceExplanations: Look at the line. The defender stands in it, right by the runner.
Right, it's false. The defender is in the way, so keep the ball.
